MMM and pure polymeric membrane; η is the enhancement coefficient, which is defined as 2.888
based on the slope of the Robeson upper bound published in 2008. This parameter was defined for
CO2/N2 in a 2008 study to assist in quantifying the effectiveness of fillers in MMMs [4].
